integrity: Proof, assumptions, normal form and finite-field calculations are included with a standalone stdlib-only verifier. Same-model scientific review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is in characteristic three, only for smooth normalized even-octic marked equations, and does not count isomorphism classes or determine full Ekedahl–Oort types. Finite-field computations are corroborative only; specialist priority review remains open.
title: Exact 3-rank strata and finite-field counts for genus-three hyperelliptic curves with an extra involution
